config system dns-database
    edit "netops-dhcp-dns.test"
        set status enable
        set domain "netops-dhcp-dns.test"
        set type primary
        set view shadow
        set ttl 86400
        set authoritative enable
        unset forwarder
        set forwarder6 ::
        set source-ip 0.0.0.0
        set source-ip6 ::
        set source-ip-interface ''
        config dns-entry
            edit 1
                set status enable
                set type A
                set ttl 0
                set hostname "dhcp-dns-a"
                set ip 198.51.100.77
            next
            edit 2
                set status enable
                set type PTR
                set ttl 300
                set hostname "dhcp-dns-a.netops-dhcp-dns.test"
                set ip 198.51.100.77
            next
        end
        set interface-select-method auto
        set vrf-select 0
        unset allow-transfer
        set primary-name "dns"
        set contact "host"
    next
end
